pe_safe_month = {
    # Reset at the monthly budget boundary, BEFORE any site completion or investment.
    # No expected construction production enters this separate safety ledger.
    pe_job_values = yes
    export_resource_income_to_variable = { resource = energy variable = pe_safe_net_energy }
      export_resource_stockpile_to_variable = { resource = energy variable = pe_safe_stock_energy }
      export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = resource_expenses_compare parameters = { resource = energy } variable = pe_safe_margin_energy }
      multiply_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_energy value = 0.05 }
      if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_energy value < 10 } } set_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_energy value = 10 } }
      if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_energy value > 250 } } set_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_energy value = 250 } }
      set_variable = { which = pe_safe_reserved_energy value = 0 }
	export_resource_income_to_variable = { resource = minerals variable = pe_safe_net_minerals }
      export_resource_stockpile_to_variable = { resource = minerals variable = pe_safe_stock_minerals }
      export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = resource_expenses_compare parameters = { resource = minerals } variable = pe_safe_margin_minerals }
      multiply_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_minerals value = 0.05 }
      if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_minerals value < 10 } } set_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_minerals value = 10 } }
      if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_minerals value > 250 } } set_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_minerals value = 250 } }
